$comment: Facet mascot tokens: the single source for the WASM workbench and the panels (README 'Mascot tokens'). From Facet main packages/ui/src/mascot.ts + styles/20-mascot.css (geometry, moods, keyframes) and tokens.json size mascot-w/h. tools/gen_mascot.mjs -> mascot_gen.h (fw::mas::), runtime core/mascot.cpp (fw::mascot). Values are device px: `v` = the 720 px panels (= the docs CSS px), `1x` = the 480 px panels. Colours and easings are names of colour.json / motion.json tokens, never values.

grid.rule: The mascot follows the foundations (Darren 2026-10-22: "I don't mind reworking corners and rules of the mascot to align with the new foundational design principles"): the body box and everything outside it ("!", z, progress dots, the hop) sit on the 4 px grid; corners come from the radius tokens, line widths from the stroke tokens. Inside the body, the eyes and their 1-2 px motions stay whole-pixel artwork: a 4 px grid there would turn every eye into the same 4 x 4 square.
foundations: Body: 32 x 24 / 20 x 16, both on the 4 px grid; corners radius.icon (8 / 4).
Strokes: brows, the "!", progress dots and the z lines are stroke.edge (2 px) wide; the happy arch is stroke.edge at 720, stroke.hair (1 px) at 480 (2 px fills a 4 px arch).
Round ends: brows, the "!" and the dots use radius.round (pill ends); the happy arch and z lines have round caps.

Grid outside the body: the "!" sits a space.1 (4 px) gap right of the body, the dots a space.1 gap under it on an 8 / 4 px pitch, the z starts on the grid at the head's top-right and drifts by grid steps; the hop is 4 px.

Whole pixels inside the body (grid too coarse there): eye sizes 1-7 px and their corners (1-3 px, below the smallest radius token, 4), eye and brow positions (they keep the docs' spacing), brow length, and the 1-2 px motions (blink, glance, scan, breathe, sigh, twitch, slump).
Colours: one colour token per mood; eyes + brows = bg; "!" accent; z text-dim (contrast pairs section mascot).
changes: Body corners 7 (docs) / 5 (firmware) -> radius.icon 8 / 4: the radius tokens, no one-off corner.
"!" at x 34 (2 px from the body) -> 36 / 24 (space.1 gap), stem 7 -> 8, top -6 -> -8 at 720; 480 stem 4, gap 2: on the grid.
z 7 px glyph, 1.75 px stroke, start (27, 5), drift (+8, -11) -> 8 px glyph, stroke.edge 2 px, start (28, 4), drift (+8, -12) at 720; 480: 4 px glyph, 2 px stroke, start (16, 4), drift (+4, -8).
Progress dots pitch 6 / 4 -> 8 / 4 (space.2 at 720), row 4 px under the body (28 / 20; was 28 / 19).
Hop 5 px (docs) -> 4 px at both densities.
Brows 2 px bars with 1 px corners -> stroke.edge pills (radius.round).
Happy arch: a partial border (stepped corners) -> an antialiased half ring with round ends.
Needs / error: no body rotation (the docs tilt 6 / 4 deg): the firmware's twitch and slump instead; a turned body smears its edges and redraws as a layer.
Each z fades as one layer instead of three strokes blending separately (darker joints while fading).

body.about: The rounded body in the mood colour; it only moves (hop, lift, slump) and gets 1 px shorter (breathe), never turns.

eye-colour.about: Eyes and brows are cut-outs in the canvas colour (on a tile too, like the docs).

eyes.$about: Left eye per shape (x, y from the body's top-left; w, h; r radius); the right eye at rx (default: mirrored, body.w - x - w). arch = a stroke-wide half ring (lv_arc, round ends: antialiased) whose box is w x w, so its top half is the arch and the round ends make the legs (docs: a 6 x 4 box with a 2 px top + side border, radius 3 3 0 0).

blink-h.about: eye height at the closed point of a blink (docs scaleY 0.2 of 5 px)

brow.about: A small bar above each eye (left one; the right mirrors it, angle negated), only in some moods. Turned about its centre; y and angle per mood.

bang.about: needs you: stem + dot above the right shoulder (x, y from the body's top-left)

z.label: z z z
z.about: sleeping: three z (3-segment polylines, round caps) start at the head's top-right corner (x, y = the z's bottom-left) and rise

dots.label: Progress dots
dots.about: working (reading): three dots under the body (x = the first dot's left edge, centred on the body), lit one after another

dot-dim.about: a progress dot that is not lit (docs 0.25; the mood colour at 25 % over the canvas is 4+ RGB565 steps from it, so it holds on the panels)

working.label: Working
working.what: calm: eyes scanning left -> right like reading, occasional blink, 3 progress dots

needs.label: Needs you
needs.what: wide eyes, raised brows, tilt, orange "!"

error.label: Error
error.what: droopy half-closed eyes, sad brows, slumps 1 px

sleeping.label: Sleeping
sleeping.what: closed eyes, slow breathing, three "z" rising up-right

reading.label: C · Reading
reading.what: eyes dart left -> right in a steady rhythm, occasional blink, 3 progress dots

typing.label: B · Typing
typing.what: eyes down at a keyboard line under the mascot, keystroke bob, blinking cursor block

thinking.label: D · Thinking
thinking.what: eyes up and to the side, one brow raised, three dots pulsing above

builder.label: E · Builder
builder.what: determined flat brows + squint, a small gear turning beside the head

instance-offset.about: per-instance phase: the n-th mascot on a view starts its desynced loops n x 1700 ms into the cycle (mod the loop), so blinks and glances of several mascots never line up (1700 is not a divisor of any desynced loop; 5200 blink -> 0, 1.7, 3.4, 5.1, 1.6 s ...). A component may pass its own delay.

motion.$about: Each pattern = one loop (or one shot) of keyframes: tracks of [t permille, value] on one part and property; between keys the pattern's easing (like CSS keyframes). Values: x / y / h in art px x amp (per density), rot in degrees, opa 0..1 (or an opacity token name), close 0..1 (eye height from its shape's h down to blink-h, centred). desync = shifted by the instance delay; stagger = each of several parts (z, dots) a further step later. reduced (motion.json reduced modes): still = no loop, the frame at `rest` permille is shown; instant = skipped.

blink.label: Blink
blink.animates: both eyes close to blink-h and open again (height + y, centred), once per loop

glance.label: Glance
glance.animates: the eyes look left, then right, then back (x of the eye group)

scan.label: Eye scan
scan.animates: the eyes run left -> right along a line (80 %), then jump back (x of the eye group)

dots.label: Progress dots
dots.animates: each dot is lit for 30 % of the loop, then dims to dot-dim; the three are a third of a loop apart (opacity)

bob.label: Bob
bob.animates: the body rises 1 px and settles (y)

breathe.label: Breathe
breathe.animates: the body gets 1 px shorter and back, bottom fixed (height + y)

hop.label: Hop
hop.animates: one hop up and a small second bounce (y), once

tilt.label: Twitch
tilt.animates: every 3 s a little twitch: the body lifts 1 px, then the eyes flick 1 px aside; the "!" dims and comes back just before (y, x of the eye group, opacity). The docs tilt the body 6 deg; the approved panel firmware drew it without rotation (a rotated body is a layer redraw and smears its 1 px edges), so this follows the firmware.

sigh.label: Sigh
sigh.animates: the eyes sink 1 px and come back (y of the eye group)

z.label: z rise
z.animates: each z fades in (15 %), drifts up-right (+8, -12 at 720; +4, -8 at 480) while growing from half to full size, fades out from 60 %; three a third of a loop apart, so one is always up (x, y, its line points, opacity of the whole z as one layer)

where: Agents tile: one mascot per agent, in the tile's top-left at the tile padding; its mood comes from the agent (working, needs you, done in the last 2 h, idle = sleeping, error / failed = error).
Empty states: one mascot above the message, idle or sleeping (nothing to show), error when loading failed.
Not on Home cards, headers, buttons, toasts or as decoration: the mascot stands for something that works for you, and only there.
rules: One mascot per view, except the Agents screen, where each tile is one agent.
The mood is the message: never animate a mascot that says nothing, never add moods, props or flourishes beyond these (character later, board facet-140).
Colour = the mood's token; a tile may pass its own colour token (same roles), never a hex.
Several on one view: each gets the instance delay (n x instance-offset) so blinks and glances never line up.
Reduced motion: every loop stops on its rest frame (the pose still shows the mood, z's stay up), the hop is skipped.
Panels: every part is a tiny LVGL object; motion changes only x, y, height, opacity and rotation, so each frame redraws a few dozen pixels.
